title: READsparrow v0.12.1: streaming CRISPR guide counting and quality control
description: Stable counting/QC release with Python/Pandas API, optional auto/mixed read orientation, optional one-substitution anchors with exact spacer matching, descriptive QC plots, small synthetic test data with independently specified expected counts/QC, regression tests, environment lock and reproduction commands. Legacy statistical hit calling is experimental; this release makes no biological FDR certification claim. The 40M-read engineering check used a repeated 500k-read fixture and 1000-guide reference, not independent biological replicates.
